name: cyberprompt
description: Automatic advisory prompt optimizer for Claude Code. Passthrough by default: a rewrite must name the defect it repairs in a machine-checked rewrite_warrant, and may never add caution the operator didn't express. A skipit marker bypasses the optimizer for one prompt. Before a non-agentic, tool-less claude -p rewrite, its private input drops Whisper credit artifacts, repetition loops, and pasted WORDRUNNER chrome. Deterministic schema, warrant, source-quote, length, content-token retention, and advisory-size gates fail open to the authoritative original; speech acts, requirements, and assumptions are all audit-logged. Includes bounded reference-resolution context, prompt-cached guidance, WORDRUNNER.EXE narration, and XP.
